page_title: GIR 5-2 ALM | Girona v Almeria 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Portu (Girona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

90+3' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Paulo Gazzaniga allowed him to make a comfortable save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lazaro (Almeria) and blew his whistle. Girona are awarded a free kick.
89' Substitution. Leo Baptistao leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marciano Sanca (Almeria).
88' Great individual play by Lazaro (Almeria) ends with a shot from distance that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
86' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Torre (Girona) replacing Ivan Martin.
85' 5 - 2 Goal! Arnau Martinez puts a cross into the box and finds Cristhian Stuani (Girona), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 5:2.
82' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Lazaro (Almeria) is replacing Adrian Embarba.
80' Michel has decided to make a change. Arnau Martinez (Girona) replaces Eric Garcia.
80' It will be a substitution. Portu (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Savio walks off.
80' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. Girona get a free kick.
78' Savio (Girona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
74' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
74' A clumsy foul by Leo Baptistao (Almeria) and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Girona will take a free kick near the side line.
73' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' The attendance is 12884.

71' 4 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Aleix Garcia, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Savio (Girona), who beats Fernando Martinez with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 4:2.
68' Substitution. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) has come on for Dion Lopy.
68' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergio Arribas.
68' Michel decides to make a substitution. Yan Couto will be replaced by Valery (Girona).
67' Substitution. Artem Dovbyk did his best and is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
66' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
66' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Girona will take a corner kick.
65' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:7.
64' Yangel Herrera (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
62' Fernando Martinez is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Miguel Gutierrez (Girona). Easy save!
59' Fernando Martinez blocks a long-range effort from Yan Couto (Girona) towards the right side of the goal.
58' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Aleix Garcia (Girona).
58' Savio (Girona) sends a cross in and finds Yan Couto inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger. Girona have a corner.
57' Almeria control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
55' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
54' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes the corner which is cleared. Almeria will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' David Lopez (Girona) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
51' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Eric Garcia (Girona) passes the ball onto Savio, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. The ball is out of play and Girona manage to earn a corner.
49' Aleix Garcia (Girona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
49' An attempted cross from Yan Couto (Girona) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
48' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Aleix Garcia (Girona) but poses no threat. The linesman signals a throw-in for Almeria.
46' Alberto Lasarte has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Chumi comes on the pitch for Lucas Robertone (Almeria).
46' The whistle blows and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+4' David Lopez (Girona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight and sees a foul from David Lopez (Girona). Almeria win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

45+1' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.
45+1' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) behaves unsportingly.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 3 - 2 Artem Dovbyk (Girona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Fernando Martinez with a strike into the left side of the goal. He makes it 3:2.

43' It looks like Aleix Garcia (Girona) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Almeria in a dangerous position.
43' Savio (Girona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
40' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
39' 2 - 2 Goal! Daley Blind tees up Artem Dovbyk (Girona) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:2.

37' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Aleix Garcia, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ivan Martin (Girona), who beats Fernando Martinez with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
36' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) meets a cross inside the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

36' Eric Garcia (Girona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Fernando Martinez pulls off an easy save.
32' Aleix Garcia (Girona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Fernando Martinez to dive and make a save.
31' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Girona are awarded the free kick.
30' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Fernando Martinez (Almeria).
29' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
26' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) earns the yellow card.
24' 0 - 2 Goal! Leo Baptistao (Almeria) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:2.

24' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Adrian Embarba (Almeria) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
24' Fernando Martinez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Artem Dovbyk (Girona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
22' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
21' Fernando Martinez blocks a long-range effort from Yangel Herrera (Girona) towards the bottom left corner. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
20' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Girona are ruled offside.
18' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Almeria was in an offside position.

16' David Lopez (Girona) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
16' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Yangel Herrera (Girona) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ivan Martin (Girona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
9' It's a goal and Ivan Martin (Girona) is the scorer!
9' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. Girona will take a free kick.
6' Almeria take a short corner kick.
4' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Leo Baptistao (Almeria) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Paulo Gazzaniga. He makes it 0:1.
